chatgpt.role: General-purpose chat assistant from OpenAI: writing, questions, search and research, files, images and voice.
chatgpt.audience: Anyone who needs a general assistant, from students to professionals and teams.
pros: Broad free plan: unlimited text chat (subject to abuse limits), limited file uploads, image generation, voice, Deep Research and memory.
Four personal plans (Free, Go, Plus, Pro). Plus adds Projects, scheduled tasks and custom GPTs; Pro offers three usage tiers.
Large context for reasoning models: 256K on Go and Plus, 400K on Pro.
cons: Small context on Free: 27K for the Instant model (about 12 pages of input).
Go may include ads, per the pricing page.
Consumer chats are used for training by default unless you opt out in settings or the privacy portal.
chatgpt.price: Plus is 20 USD/month. Free plan exists. Go and Pro prices not verified.
chatgpt.free: Permanent Free plan: unlimited text chat (abuse limits apply), limited uploads, image generation, voice, Deep Research, memory, Codex. 27K context on Instant.
plans: Unlimited text chat (abuse limits), limited uploads, images, voice, Deep Research, memory, Codex.
More messages, uploads, images and voice than Free; longer memory; 54K context on Instant, 256K on reasoning. May include ads.
Everything in Go plus advanced reasoning, Projects, scheduled tasks, custom GPTs, extended Codex, early features. Limits apply.
Everything in Plus plus 3 usage tiers, Dot agent, unlimited images, max Deep Research and memory, monthly API credits. 128K Instant / 400K reasoning context.
Monthly or annual billing, 2+ users.
chatgpt.privacy: Per OpenAI's policy (updated 13 Mar 2026), chats are used for training unless you opt out via the privacy portal or Data Controls; Temporary Chats are not used. Team, Enterprise and API are not trained on by default. The page does not name Go, Pro or Edu.
chatgpt.api: Yes. Pro includes monthly API credits. API docs and pricing not read.
chatgpt.hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the interface language list in the help page does not include it. No official page found on model language support.
chatgpt.students: No student discount on the pricing page. ChatGPT Edu exists for universities (no public price); ChatGPT for Teachers is free for verified US K-12 teachers through June 2027.
chatgpt.watch: Users report support and refund requests get automated replies only.

claude.role: Assistant from Anthropic for writing, file analysis, research, and creating documents, presentations and code.
claude.audience: Students, writers, researchers and developers working with long documents, files and code.
pros: Many tools free: Free includes web search, file creation, code execution, memory, app connections, Artifacts, Claude Design, Slides and Docs.
Annual discount: Pro is 20 USD monthly or 17 USD/month billed yearly (200 USD upfront).
Documented API with public pricing: Opus 5.5 is 4 USD per million input tokens and 20 USD output; also on AWS, Google Cloud and Azure.
cons: Usage is capped per 5-hour window and per week on all plans. Max gives 5x Pro, Ultra 10x.
Opus, Claude Code and Research need Pro or above; Free has Sonnet and Haiku and up to 5 Projects.
Interface has no Hebrew, though you can write to Claude in any language.
claude.price: Pro is 20 USD/month, or 17 USD/month billed yearly. Free plan with renewing quota.
claude.free: Permanent Free plan; quota renews per 5-hour window and weekly. Includes Sonnet and Haiku, web search, file creation, code execution, memory, Artifacts, up to 5 Projects.
plans: Limited use per 5-hour window and week. Web, desktop, mobile; web search, file creation, code execution, memory, app connections, Artifacts, Design, Slides, Docs; up to 5 Projects; Sonnet and Haiku.
More usage than Free, Opus, Claude Code, Claude Science, unlimited Projects, Research, Claude in Chrome and Microsoft 365, task scheduling, Data, Sheets and Whiteboards (beta).
5x Pro usage per 5 hours and week, Fable up to half the weekly quota, 100 USD/month API credits, early access, priority at peak times.
10x Pro weekly, no 5-hour limit (verified accounts), Fable up to half weekly quota, 200 USD/month API credits.
2 to 150 users; more usage than Pro, Claude Code, Cowork, SSO, central billing, no training by default.
5x Standard seat usage.
Minimum 20 seats plus API-rate usage.
Whole-university plan for students, staff and employees, plus API credits for learning.
claude.privacy: Per Anthropic's privacy center (16 Mar 2026), consumer Free, Pro and Max chats may improve models if you allow it in the Model Improvement setting; default not stated. Incognito chats are not used. Chats flagged for safety review may be used. Thumb feedback is kept up to 5 years. Team: no training by default.
claude.api: Yes. Claude Platform API. Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5) is 4/20 USD per million input/output tokens, 8/40 in fast mode; also on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure. Max and Ultra include monthly API credits.
claude.hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the official interface languages (English, French, German, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish) exclude it. You can chat in any language and it replies in the language you write.
claude.students: No personal student discount. Education plan for institutions (students, staff, employees), discounted by quote.
claude.watch: Users report accounts blocked without explanation, and bot-only support.

gemini.role: Google's chat assistant for writing, research, image and video generation, and work with Google services.
gemini.audience: Google users who want an assistant connected to Gmail, storage and Google's creative tools.
pros: Free plan with many tools: image generation and editing, Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, limited Google Flow access and 15GB storage.
Cheap paid tier: Google AI Plus is 4.99 USD/month in the US, 2x Free usage, video generation, 200 Flow credits, 400GB storage.
Bundle with storage and Google services: Google AI Pro at 19.99 USD/month has 4x Free usage, 1,000 Flow credits, Antigravity, YouTube Premium Lite and 5TB.
cons: Free is limited to the Flash-Lite model; Gemini 4 Argon needs Google AI Pro or Ultra.
Chats may be used for training and human review: with History on, Google trains on chats and some are reviewed by humans and kept up to 3 years.
Checked prices are US prices in dollars; other countries not checked.
gemini.price: From 4.99 USD/month (Google AI Plus, US price). Free plan exists.
gemini.free: Free with a Google account: Flash-Lite, images, Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, limited Google Flow, 15GB storage. Quota size and renewal not stated.
gemini.trial: Page links to a free trial, but length and terms were not shown or verified.
plans: Flash-Lite, image generation and editing, Deep Research, Gemini Live, Canvas, Skills, limited Google Flow (limited Nano Banana Pro), 15GB.
2x Free usage, video generation, Daily Brief, 200 Flow credits, Gemini in Gmail and Vids, 400GB.
4x Free usage, Gemini 4 Argon, video, 1,000 Flow credits, Antigravity, Google Home Premium (Standard), YouTube Premium Lite, 5TB; 1M-token context per the page FAQ.
5x Pro usage, max access to Gemini 4 Carbon, Argon and Hydrogen, 10,000 Flow credits, Project Genie, YouTube Premium, from 20TB.
Top Ultra tier: 20x Pro usage and 25,000 Flow credits.
Up to 300 seats, 2TB pooled storage per user.
Unlimited seats and higher quotas.
gemini.privacy: Per the Gemini Apps privacy hub (updated 16 Nov 2026), with History on Google uses future chats to train models; default not stated. Some chats are human-reviewed and kept up to 3 years. You can turn History off or stop training use; temporary chats are not used. Gemini Live audio, video and screen sharing are not used by default. Work and school accounts have different terms.
gemini.api: Yes. Google AI Studio and Antigravity are free to start with paid upgrade; Gemini platform is pay-per-use with a free trial. API price list not read.
gemini.hebrew: Not verified: the help page on supported languages and countries did not load.
gemini.students: The plans page links to a 'For Students' area but shows no student price or discount; not verified.

microsoft-copilot.role: Microsoft's chat assistant, free and built into Microsoft 365 apps such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
microsoft-copilot.audience: Windows and Microsoft 365 users who want an assistant inside Office tools.
pros: Copilot inside Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook for desktop with Microsoft 365 Personal, Family and Premium.
Bundle with storage and Office: Microsoft 365 Personal is 9.99 USD/month or 99.99 USD/year with 1TB storage.
One free month: 'Try free for 1 month' on Personal, Family and Premium, subject to offer terms and region.
cons: Free version is capacity-limited: 'limited free version of Copilot subject to available capacity and limits', no numeric quota.
On Family and Premium, AI features are for the subscription owner only and cannot be shared.
AI-generated audio is English only on all plans.
microsoft-copilot.price: Basic Copilot is free. Microsoft 365 Personal with Copilot is 9.99 USD/month or 99.99 USD/year.
microsoft-copilot.free: Limited free Copilot, subject to available capacity and limits. Quota and renewal not published.
microsoft-copilot.trial: One free month for Personal, Family and Premium. Eligibility, continuation and payment details vary by offer and region.
plans: Limited free version, subject to capacity and limits.
1 user, up to 5 devices, 1TB, Copilot in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook on desktop, advanced chat with more usage than Free, image generation.
1 to 6 people, 2TB shared. Copilot for the owner only.
1 to 6 people (AI for owner only), 2TB, advanced chat with extensive usage, Premium and Pro exclusive features, limited agent use including advanced research.
Up to 6 people, 5TB, highest chat, agent, image and audio usage. Includes everything in Premium.
microsoft-copilot.privacy: Per Copilot privacy FAQ (updated 11 Mar 2026), Microsoft trains on conversations 'except for certain categories of users or users who have opted out'. Excluded: organization accounts, Copilot inside Microsoft 365 Personal or Family, signed-out users, under-18s and users in several countries including Israel. The page covers the older app version; the current version (since 18 Aug 2026) and web have another privacy page that was not read.
microsoft-copilot.api: Not verified: whether the consumer assistant has an API was not checked.
microsoft-copilot.hebrew: Not verified: the help page on supported regions and languages did not load.
microsoft-copilot.students: Per pricing FAQ, students 'may qualify for special Microsoft education offers and discounts', including discounted Microsoft 365; some institutions give access free. No price; eligibility depends on institution and region.

perplexity.role: Answer engine that searches the web and returns a summarized answer with sources, including a deep research mode.
perplexity.audience: Students and researchers who need search-based answers with sources.
pros: Discount for students: Education Pro is 10 USD/month for verified students and educators via SheerID, everything in Pro plus Learn Mode.
Free plan has 'near-unlimited basic searches', 3 Pro searches a day and 1 Research query a month.
Pay-per-use API with credit purchase; per the help page no data logging or retention.
cons: Free has no advanced models, image generation or file/app creation, and limited uploads.
Pro quotas are weekly and monthly by 'average use', no published numbers.
API subscription is separate: no free credits and no access to Pro features in the interface.
perplexity.price: Free plan exists. Education Pro for verified students is 10 USD/month. Regular Pro price not verified.
perplexity.free: Free Standard plan: near-unlimited basic searches, 3 Pro searches a day, 1 Research query a month, limited uploads.
plans: Search history, near-unlimited basic searches, 3 Pro searches/day, 1 Research query/month, limited file upload.
Weekly and monthly quotas by 'average use' for Pro searches, Research, Comet Assistant and files. Advanced models, image and video generation, up to 50 files per project.
Everything in Pro, Perplexity Computer, Learn Mode and advanced models.
Everything in Pro at 'advanced use' quotas, early access to new products, Brain preview.
400 Pro searches/week, 50 Research queries/month, 80 Browser Agent queries/month, no training on data.
4,000 Pro searches/week, 500 Research queries/month.
perplexity.privacy: Not verified for personal plans: privacy policy and data-retention help page not read. Per the plans help page, Enterprise Pro data is 'never used for training' and the API does not log or retain data.
perplexity.api: Yes. Pay-per-use API platform, buy credits or auto-top-up. No free credits. API price list not read.
perplexity.hebrew: Not verified: no official page on supported languages found or read.
perplexity.students: Education Pro at 10 USD/month for students and educators verified via SheerID, with everything in Pro plus Learn Mode; 'auto-applied' per the discount page. For institutions: Enterprise Pro at 30 USD/user/month or 300/year.
perplexity.watch: Users report billing that continued after cancellation and a cumbersome cancellation process.

deepseek.role: Chat assistant from a Chinese company, on web and app, with a cheap pay-per-use API.
deepseek.audience: Users and developers who want a low-cost assistant and API and accept data stored in China.
pros: Low API price: deepseek-flash input is 0.15-0.3 USD per million tokens, output 0.6-1.2 USD, half price off-peak.
New model on web, app and API: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, released 17 Oct 2026.
cons: Data is stored in China: personal data is collected, processed and stored in the People's Republic of China, per the privacy policy.
Data used for training; opt-out only by email to privacy@deepseek.com.
Free-use terms not published: the official pages show no price or quota for web and app chat.
deepseek.price: API is pay-per-use, from 0.15 USD per million input tokens. Web and app chat price not verified.
plans: Input 0.15-0.3 USD, output 0.6-1.2 USD per million tokens. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. Cached input 0.003-0.006 USD.
Input 0.66-1.32 USD, output 1.98-3.96 USD per million tokens. DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813.
deepseek.privacy: Per the privacy policy (last update 10 Feb 2026), one use of data is 'to train and improve our technology'. Users may opt out of training use by email to privacy@deepseek.com. Data is collected, processed and stored in the People's Republic of China.
deepseek.api: Yes. Pay-per-use API with deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro, half price off-peak. Also a speech API (TTS, ASR) and Search & Fetch at 0.75 USD per 1,000 calls.
deepseek.hebrew: Not verified: no official language page read.
deepseek.students: No student offer found on the pages checked.

grok.role: Chat assistant with voice, image and video generation and build tools, from the makers of Grok at x.ai.
grok.audience: Users who want an assistant with voice, images and video on a relatively cheap plan.
pros: Cheap paid plan: Plus is 8 USD/month with Grok Chat, Voice, Imagine, Build and Grok API access.
Quotas refresh weekly. Premium gives 4x Plus, Super 15x, Ultra 50x.
API access from Plus; API use is billed separately at model rates and does not draw down the subscription quota.
cons: Free is limited: chat and agent quota is 'Limited', no numbers.
Image and video generation and 'Latest Grok models' start at Premium, 30 USD/month.
Monthly billing only, before tax: no annual option on the page. 'Prices subject to change'.
grok.price: From 8 USD/month (Plus), before tax. Limited free plan exists.
grok.free: Free plan with limited chat and agent use. Quotas refresh weekly per the pricing page; free quota size not stated.
plans: Limited chat and agent use.
Shared usage pool, Grok Chat, Voice, Imagine, Build, Grok API access, Cursor.
4x Plus usage, Grok Bot, newest models, faster answers, images and video, code storage, cloud agents.
15x Plus usage and priority at peak times.
50x Plus usage.
grok.privacy: Not verified: privacy policy and terms not read.
grok.api: Yes. Grok API access included from Plus, billed separately at model rates. Model price list not read.
grok.hebrew: Not verified: no official language page read.
grok.students: The pricing page mentions no student offer.

meta-ai.role: Meta's chat assistant, free for everyone, with extended image and video generation in the Meta One subscription.
meta-ai.audience: Users of Meta apps who want a free assistant and image and video generation.
pros: Free for everyone: per the Meta One plans page, Meta AI is free for all users; subscribers get more usage.
Cheap subscription for images and video: Meta One Personal Core is 7.99 USD/month with higher AI usage, including image editing and generation, video, voice and effects.
cons: Quotas not published: the page gives no free-plan limits or the size of the subscriber boost.
Availability and prices depend on region: Meta One is 'not available in all regions'; prices and features vary by country, app and account.
meta-ai.price: Meta AI is free. Meta One Personal Core subscription is 7.99 USD/month; price varies by country.
meta-ai.free: Meta AI is free for everyone per the page. Quotas and renewal not stated.
plans: Free for everyone. Quotas not stated.
Higher AI usage, including image editing and generation, video, voice and effects.
Extended AI usage and more video generation.
Creator tiers Essential (14.99), Advanced (49.99), Expert (149.00) and Max (499.00) per profile, with higher AI usage for images, video and voice.
meta-ai.privacy: Not verified: privacy policy and Meta AI terms not read.

mistral-vibe.role: Mistral AI's chat assistant (formerly Le Chat) for chat, search, document work and code.
mistral-vibe.audience: Students and users who want a cheap European assistant, including code work.
mistral-vibe.status: Renamed: Le Chat is now Mistral Vibe. Chats, settings and subscriptions move to the new service.
pros: Big student discount: verified students at recognized higher-education institutions get Pro at 5.99 USD/month instead of 14.99, for up to 12 months.
Available almost everywhere: web, iOS and Android apps, macOS and Windows apps, command line and VS Code, plus JetBrains and Zed via ACP per the page.
API credits inside Pro: '15 USD/mo in API credits' and 6x Free messages and searches.
cons: Training on data by default: on Free, Pro, Teams and Student your data is used for training unless you opt out; only Enterprise is excluded by default.
Free is limited in messages, searches and code sessions, with basic image generation only.
Pro is 14.99 USD/month excluding taxes, with no annual option on the page.
mistral-vibe.price: Pro is 14.99 USD/month before tax, 5.99 USD for verified students. Free plan exists.
mistral-vibe.free: Free plan: limited messages, web searches and code sessions, basic image generation, 100+ connectors. Quota size and renewal not stated.
plans: Limited messages, web searches and code sessions, basic image generation and editing, 100+ connectors, web and mobile, up to 5 scheduled tasks.
Up to 6x Free messages and searches, up to 40x image generation, 15GB library, unlimited scheduled tasks, 15 USD/month API credits.
Pro plan.
Higher quotas, up to 30GB storage per user, domain verification, data export.
Custom models and agents, audit logs, SAML SSO.
mistral-vibe.privacy: Per Mistral's help center (undated), on Vibe Free, Pro, Teams and Student, input and output data are 'used by default' for model training; opt out any time. Enterprise is excluded by default. Opt-out does not apply to Labs and Public Preview models, and feedback with a comment permits use of that chat on any plan.
mistral-vibe.api: Yes. Pro includes 15 USD/month in API credits. Mistral Studio has a free mode and a pay-per-use mode. API price list not read.
mistral-vibe.hebrew: Source does not mention Hebrew: the product page shows only the site languages (English, French, Italian) and does not list product languages.
mistral-vibe.students: Pro at 5.99 USD/month (before tax) instead of 14.99, for verified students at recognized higher-education institutions who have not used Vibe or Le Chat before, for up to 12 months.
